abilities.name: sturdy
abilities.descriptionEs: Evita que el rival pueda debilitarlo de un solo golpe cuando tiene los PS al máximo. También evita los movimientos fulminantes.
abilities.descriptionEn: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

acquisitions.game: Lets Go Pikachu - Lets Go Eevee
